definitions.explanation: Going to the furthest possible point; far from moderate or average.

examples.japanese: {極端的|きょくたんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to avoid extreme ways of thinking.

examples.japanese: {極端的|きょくたんてき}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げてみよう→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Let me give an extreme example.

examples.japanese: {極端的|きょくたんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Put extremely, it was a failure.

notes:
{極端的|きょくたんてき} is a na-adjective meaning extreme or radical.

FORMS:
Formed from ⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧ (extreme) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix).
- Adverbial: {極端的|きょくたんてき}に (extremely, radically)
- Modifier: {極端的|きょくたんてき}な + noun (extreme ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {極端的|きょくたんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: extreme way of thinking
- {極端的|きょくたんてき}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧: an extreme example
- {極端的|きょくたんてき}に⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: to put it in extreme terms

USAGE:
The base word {極端|きょくたん} is more commonly used on its own as a na-adjective ({極端|きょくたん}な) or adverb ({極端|きょくたん}に). The {的|てき} form adds a slightly more formal or analytical tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{過激|かげき}→過激：14325_kageki⟧: radical, extreme (often about actions or political views)
- ⟦{極度|きょくど}→極度：13141_kyokudo⟧の: extreme, utmost (emphasizes degree)
